english.note: Use 隔離 as the all-purpose choice for putting people or things apart, including quarantine and self-isolation.

exampleSentences.english: The doctor told me to isolate at home and not go anywhere.
exampleSentences.traditional: 醫生叫我留喺屋企隔離，唔好周圍去。
